setup_pr.title: Implement local maintenance and source-free publisher recovery
setup_pr.body:
Current commit 6869eb328d314730f079f7a6430e15f5f5965378, tree 74535782ef1c0f9f89f68d3078022ff598f724d9: [CI 38837873974 / attempt 1](https://github.com/Julesc013/universal-setup/actions/runs/38837873974) completed with failure. Six jobs passed. Windows x64 passed fresh repair/move/uninstall in both modes but failed both genuinely interrupted, source-retired repair.recover requests at the unchanged 120-second deadline. This draft remains unqualified for merging; R93 has not established a recovery cure.

All four original receipts and 44 native JSON hashes are retained and independently reconciled. Both recoveries returned their own request-bound CLI UNKNOWN envelope, with no native observation file. Original worker pairs positively ended and source retirement is verified. Later incomplete, non-atomic journal readbacks do not establish native completion or restoration. Diagnostic observer closure does not qualify worker cleanup: account cleanup is confirmed, but client cleanup and launcher-task removal are unconfirmed. Retained diagnostics do not establish a cause, speedup or runtime/release acceptance. The source and local-control details below remain applicable with their hosted-status wording corrected.

Implement local maintenance and source-free publisher recovery. This accumulated draft remains unfinished. The existing AIDE update and project customizations are preserved.

Current checkpoint 6869eb328d314730f079f7a6430e15f5f5965378, tree 74535782ef1c0f9f89f68d3078022ff598f724d9, composes the original pending-recovery inspection/reconciliation, compatible-before postimage admissibility and following exact prefix pin in one fixed private read-only recipe when the fault injector is absent. The actual protected recovery caller reaches this path independently of replacement-file count. Exact original authority/effect target types and current weak native binding select it. Present injectors, already-applied observations and ordinary/replaced/wrapped/SCM/ineligible backends retain their existing path.

Every actual initial/closing TX/history read, snapshot/resumability predicate, reconciliation binding, postimage read/parse/digest check and following exact pin remains. Discarded postimages stay discarded. The complete original-record/global exit and typed weak-owner revalidation precede all outputs, including the completion flag. The caller skips only those completed reads. Concrete effect checks, post-effect reconciliation, completion pin/journal and final checks remain independent and unchanged. No callback, effect, grant or journal write occurs inside the recipe. Both raw9 rounds, duplicate ancestry occurrences, actual bytes, final joins, positive closes and PrefixReadRecipe implementation remain. Former intermediate global sampling instants/error chronology are unclaimed; begun-recipe refusal remains sticky.

Independent source review and current local controls passed:437 Python controls plus strict/structure/license/client-cleanup/diff checks, all16 native controls in the reused serial Release build, and nine actual x86 /Zs /W4 /WX inputs against77 frozen source pins. Expanded ordinary/replaced/wrapped decline controls cover both preparation inputs, unchanged outputs/flag and zero callback counts. They do not manufacture a native owner or prove eligible native failure/poison closure. Five code/test SHA values changed across46 inventory observations without classification changes. C++17/C ABI1.0, package/wire/persisted formats, parser/proof/buffer bounds and120-second deadlines remain. Exact-head hosted CI 38837873974/attempt1 failed both recovery deadlines; no speedup or deadline cure is established.

Parent c0d768e CI38829055547/attempt1 failed both genuinely ended-original/source-retired repair.recover deadlines. Six other jobs and fresh repair/move/uninstall in both modes passed. The four originals and44 native JSON hashes are retained and independently reconciled. Both recoveries remain request-bound UNKNOWN/no native observation, with incomplete installed-record readback/error32 and unconfirmed client/task cleanup. Original pairs positively ended and original sources retired. Later non-atomic journal tails and CLI exit5 do not establish native completion, restoration or a timely response; the later traced fixture may include prior failure interference.

The reconciled parent trace has7559 rows/3775 pairs/nine unmatched endpoints. Conditional PID4000/thread5556 has a32.291795s retained window with217 record-proof pairs totaling25.515711 inclusive seconds and113 authority pairs17.737076 inclusive seconds. Nested/differently populated stages cannot be added/subtracted into exclusive costs. These measurements motivate the connected repeated-boundary hypothesis; eligible-call count, savings, whole capture, native birth/request clock and timeout cause remain unestablished. All original archive bytes, CSV, facts and reviews are preserved under the unchanged20GiB cap.

Inventory remains29implemented/65partial/46absent/4unverified of144; mandatory Foundation20/51/34/4 of109; acceptance_not_run. These are source classifications. The existing finite maintenance/initial-recovery, four SDK/package, accumulated compatibility, current base/ruleset and WorkUnit gates remain before normal dev AND main integration. Ordinary public strict SDK installation,1.1.0 Local Setup Foundation and the wider specification remain unfinished.
